name: BF Dune Buggy
summary: Lightweight off-road buggy built for Grassrivers terrain. Excellent off-road handling on swamp dirt tracks. Seen during Mud Bogging activity sequences.
description: The BF Dune Buggy is a lightweight open-frame off-road vehicle inspired by the classic Meyers Manx. Purpose-built for Grassrivers terrain, it excels on the swamp dirt tracks, shallow water crossings, and muddy trails that define southern Leonida. Its roll cage, long-travel suspension, and high ground clearance are on display during the game's Mud Bogging side activity sequences.
